title: DEC-301 (a4) item 2: derive the release notes' signing wording from the signed file and fail the tag on a mismatch
description: DEC-301 (a4) item 2. Today the release notes say "ad-hoc signature" (scripts/release-metadata.mjs CDHASH_LINE ties the wording) and nothing stops a Developer ID tag from publishing that. Derive the notes signing wording from the signed file own codesign output (the sign job regenerates the notes from the signed bytes) and add a test that fails the tag when notes and signature disagree. It must land before the first Developer ID tag and does not wait for the rehearsal. The Keychain re-approval sentence stays held until the operator Mac measurement, and the README keychain paragraph (ad-hoc signed, a new build is a new identity) is reworded with it. Also carries the #420 confirmatory-review items N1 to N7: N1 mirror the bare rejections in quoted form for the requirement step test (missing anchor, wrong identifier, extra clause after the OU, prefix team), add a digit-leading quoted positive control such as 1BCDE2345X, and make the case-line pin line-exact; N2 assert stdout has no line starting with :: other than ::error::, make the cdhash block testable on its own, drop the redundant unset case; N3 real codesign may print a leading # on the designated line, add to the publish runbook rehearsal checks; N4 pin the set-key-partition-list redirect with a marker in the fake and note that a failure there exits with no diagnostic; N5 widen the trace regex to set -Eux and set -o pipefail -x; N6 put the Developer ID leaf marker certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.13] pin in the publish runbook Read the run before any tag list; N7 note the C locale of the behavioural test versus the runner locale. Paths: scripts/release-metadata.mjs, scripts/regenerate-release-metadata.mjs, its three test files (test/release-metadata.test.ts and the two other tests that pin the wording), .github/workflows/release.yml, test/release-workflow.test.ts, docs/runbooks/publish-a-mac-signed-ward-release-asset.md, README.md. Classes: CI workflow and release path; floor sonnet; Opus review.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The release notes signing wording is derived from the signed file own codesign output, not a fixed string
A test fails the release when the notes and the signature disagree, for both an ad-hoc and a Developer ID signature
N1 to N7 from the #420 confirmatory review are each addressed or recorded as declined with a reason
The Keychain re-approval sentence is unchanged until the operator Mac measurement

implementationNotes: Built on wcli-186-notes-signing-guard. regenerate-release-metadata.mjs derives the signature from codesign -dvvv of the signed file; rewriteNotes takes it as a required argument, rewrites the cdhash line and drops the ad-hoc closing sentence for Developer ID (no Keychain claim), and assertNotesMatchSignature fails the sign job on any disagreement either way. verify-published-release.sh accepts both labels but does not compare wording with the signature (declined: the sign job does, and the cdhash and bytes are still compared). N1 to N7 done: quoted rejections and digit-leading control, line-exact case pin and arm list; cdhash block reached alone and no stray :: lines; N3, N6, N7 in the publish runbook rehearsal list; N4 partition-list marker in the fake; N5 widened trace regex. Unmeasured: real codesign -dvvv output shape for a Developer ID signature (Authority/TeamIdentifier/Identifier lines) is from Apple documentation and the design, not a run; the darwin-only test uses a fake codesign. Local full suite: 1745 pass, 1 fail (the pre-existing TPM test).
